summary: This joint resolution blocks the Department of Energy rule setting new energy conservation standards for consumer gas-fired instantaneous water heaters by declaring the rule has no force or effect.

scores.thoughts: The bill uses the Congressional Review Act to nullify a specific DOE energy efficiency rule. It contains no provisions related to federal spending levels, appropriations, or budget authority.
No tax provisions, rate changes, credits, or revenue measures appear in the text.
The legislation addresses an appliance efficiency standard and has no connection to health insurance, medical care delivery, or public health programs.
No references to firearms, regulations, or Second Amendment issues.
The bill is silent on immigration policy, border security, or legal status.
No content related to reproductive health services or abortion access.
No defense authorizations, military spending, or national security provisions.

The joint resolution expressly disapproves and nullifies a Department of Energy energy-conservation standard for gas-fired instantaneous water heaters (89 Fed. Reg. 105188). This directly prevents implementation of a federal efficiency regulation intended to reduce energy consumption and associated emissions, thereby limiting environmental regulation in the energy sector.
No welfare, entitlement, or social-services provisions.
No education funding, school-choice, or federal education policy content.
No drug enforcement, decriminalization, or controlled-substance measures.
No sentencing, policing, or criminal-justice reform provisions.
No tariffs, trade agreements, or import/export regulations.
The measure does not address deficits, debt ceiling, or fiscal consolidation.
No provisions concerning LGBTQ legal protections or related civil-rights issues.
No foreign-assistance authorizations or funding changes.
No election administration, voting access, or campaign-finance content.
No technology regulation, data privacy, or digital-platform provisions.
No labor, union, or workplace-regulation measures.
No religious-exemption or anti-discrimination provisions.
